title: CT Radiomics of Epicardial Adipose Tissue for Predicting Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review.
summary:
RATIONALE AND OBJECTIVES: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common arrhythmia, affecting 1-2% of the general population. Epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) may contribute to AF through its proximity to the myocardium and coronary vessels, as well as its vasocrine and paracrine functions. Previous studies linked EAT thickness and volume with AF incidence. This review consolidates evidence on the correlation between radiomic analysis of EAT and the incidence of AF.

MATERIAL AND METHODS: This systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO). Embase, PubMed, MEDLINE, Web of Science, and Google Scholar were searched for primary studies using CT-based EAT radiomics to predict AF. Case reports, animal studies, pediatric populations, and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)/ultrasound studies were excluded. Risk of bias was assessed with PROBAST, and methodological quality with the Radiomics Quality Score.

RESULTS: Ten studies, including 2952 patients (53.8-81.4% male; mean age range 42.2-74.1 years), met eligibility. Six were retrospective, and four were prospective. The studies evaluated postoperative AF, AF recurrence after catheter ablation, AF detection, and AF subtype classification. Reported machine learning models included random forest, logistic regression, Cox regression, and Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO). Performance metrics ranged from AUC 0.73-0.92, sensitivity 0.50-0.90 and specificity 0.53-0.98. Segmentation methods and feature extraction varied, and external validation was rare.

CONCLUSION: Machine learning models using EAT radiomic features show promise for AF prediction. However, this heterogeneity limits generalizability and precludes immediate incorporation into clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 系统综述纳入10项研究、共2952例患者，显示基于CT的心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）影像组学联合机器学习模型预测房颤（术后房颤、消融后复发、房颤检出及亚型分类）的AUC为0.73-0.92，但因分割与特征提取异质性大、缺乏外部验证，尚不能直接用于临床。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的心律失常，影响普通人群的1%-2%。心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）因与心肌和冠状动脉毗邻，并具有血管分泌和旁分泌功能，可能参与房颤的发生。既往研究多聚焦于EAT厚度与体积和房颤发生率的关系，而EAT影像组学（radiomics）特征与房颤发生及复发之间关系的研究证据尚缺乏系统整合，本研究即对此进行汇总评价，以明确其在房颤风险分层中的潜在价值与证据缺口。
AI.method: 本研究为遵循PRISMA 2020并在PROSPERO注册的系统综述。检索Embase、PubMed、MEDLINE、Web of Science和Google Scholar，纳入使用CT-based EAT影像组学预测房颤的原始研究；排除病例报告、动物研究、儿童人群以及基于MRI或超声的研究。采用PROBAST评估偏倚风险，采用影像组学质量评分（Radiomics Quality Score）评估方法学质量。共10项研究、2952例患者符合纳入标准（男性占53.8%-81.4%，平均年龄范围42.2-74.1岁），其中回顾性6项、前瞻性4项；预测场景包括术后房颤、导管消融后房颤复发、房颤检出及房颤亚型分类；所用机器学习模型包括随机森林、逻辑回归、Cox回归和LASSO。
AI.result: 共10项研究、2952例患者纳入分析，报告的性能指标范围为AUC 0.73-0.92、敏感度0.50-0.90、特异度0.53-0.98。各研究在图像分割方法和特征提取流程上存在明显差异，外部验证罕见。摘要未报告合并效应量（如汇总AUC及其95%CI）、各预测场景的分层结果，也未报告PROBAST偏倚风险评分和影像组学质量评分的具体分布。
AI.conclusion: 基于EAT影像组学特征联合机器学习模型对房颤预测显示出一定前景，可用于术后房颤、消融后复发、房颤检出及亚型分类等多种场景。但研究间在分割算法、特征提取与建模方法上异质性显著，且缺乏外部验证，限制了结论的可推广性，目前尚不具备直接进入临床实践的条件。未来需推进分割与特征提取的标准化、开展多中心前瞻性外部验证，并在电生理实践中与临床及电解剖标测变量联合建模以评估增量价值。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常，影响普通人群的1-2%。心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）可能通过其与心肌和冠状血管的邻近关系，以及其血管分泌和旁分泌功能，促进AF的发生。既往研究将EAT厚度和体积与AF发生率相关联。本综述汇总关于EAT影像组学分析与AF发生率之间相关性的证据。

材料与方法：本系统综述按照PRISMA 2020开展，并在国际前瞻性系统综述注册平台（PROSPERO）注册。检索了Embase、PubMed、MEDLINE、Web of Science和Google Scholar，纳入使用基于CT的EAT影像组学预测AF的原始研究。病例报告、动物研究、儿童人群以及磁共振成像（MRI）/超声研究被排除。采用PROBAST评估偏倚风险，采用影像组学质量评分（Radiomics Quality Score）评估方法学质量。

结果：共10项研究、包括2952例患者（男性占53.8-81.4%；平均年龄范围42.2-74.1岁）符合纳入标准。其中6项为回顾性研究，4项为前瞻性研究。这些研究评估了术后AF、导管消融后AF复发、AF检出以及AF亚型分类。所报告的机器学习模型包括随机森林、logistic回归、Cox回归以及最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）。性能指标范围为AUC 0.73-0.92、敏感度0.50-0.90、特异度0.53-0.98。分割方法和特征提取方法各不相同，外部验证罕见。

结论：使用EAT影像组学特征的机器学习模型在AF预测方面显示出前景。然而，这种异质性限制了其可推广性，并使其无法立即纳入临床实践。

title: Epicardial Connection as a Resource of Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Pulsed Field Ablation: A Case Report
summary: This case highlights an uncommon but clinically important mechanism of atrial fibrillation recurrence after Pulsed field ablation. It emphasizes the importance of ablation along the ridge during the first session and also the need for careful evaluation of epicardial conduction, particularly in patients with a left common pulmonary vein.

AI.tldr: 本病例报告提示，脉冲场消融后房颤复发可源于心外膜连接，在合并左共肺静脉解剖的患者中尤需警惕，首次手术应重视嵴部消融并评估心外膜传导。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）已广泛用于房颤的肺静脉隔离，但术后复发机制尚未充分阐明；心外膜连接作为肺静脉—左房之间的旁路传导通路，是既往射频/冷冻消融时代已被认识、却少见的复发原因，而 PFA 背景下相关证据匮乏，易在再次消融时被漏诊。
AI.method: 研究类型为单例病例报告（Clin Case Rep），研究对象为 1 例 PFA 术后房颤复发、且合并左共肺静脉解剖的患者；干预为再次导管消融术中对心外膜传导的标测与靶向消融；终点为复发机制的识别与消融策略评价。患者年龄、PFA 参数、标测系统细节、复发时间及随访时长等，摘要未报告；未涉及组间比较与统计学检验。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量数据（无效应量、95%CI 或 P 值）。定性结果显示：再次手术标测证实心外膜连接是本次房颤复发的来源，针对该通路的消融可处理复发；作者同时指出，首次手术中沿嵴部（ridge）进行消融、以及在合并左共肺静脉的患者中细致评估心外膜传导，对预防复发具有重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该病例提示，PFA 术后房颤复发需将心外膜连接纳入鉴别，尤其在左共肺静脉解剖者中；首次手术应注重嵴部消融的完整性，再次手术时应系统性评估心外膜传导，避免仅依赖肺静脉电位隔离这一终点。局限性明确：证据来自单例报告，无法推断心外膜连接的发生率、预测因素或对总体复发率的贡献，也缺乏标准化的标测与消融流程，尚需病例系列或队列研究验证。

summary_zh: 本病例突出了脉冲场消融术后心房颤动复发的一种不常见但在临床上具有重要意义的发生机制。它强调了在首次手术中沿嵴进行消融的重要性，同时也强调需要仔细评估心外膜传导，尤其是在左共同肺静脉的患者中。

title: Subclinical Atrial Fibrillation: Detection, Stroke Risk, and Treatment
summary: Background Clinically evident atrial fibrillation is estimated to affect more than 1.8 million people in Germany. Atrial arrhythmias are increasingly being detected by cardiac devices and wearables in asymptomatic persons without any history of atrial fibrillation. Such cases are usually designated as "subclinical atrial fibrillation." With the limited and, in part, inconsistent evidence now available, it remains unclear whether this condition is medically relevant and an indication for oral anticoagulation.Methods This review is based on pertinent publications (2005-2025) retrieved by a selective search in the PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library databases on subclinical atrial fibrillation, atrial high-rate episodes (AHRE), and device- or wearable-detected atrial fibrillation.Results Subclinical atrial fibrillation is associated with an elevated risk of stroke that increases with episode duration and arrhythmia burden. Observational studies have shown that device-detected episodes lasting 6 minutes or longer elevate the stroke risk by a factor of 2 to 2.5, yielding an absolute risk that is still lower than that of patients with clinically evident atrial fibrillation. No direct causal or temporal relationship has been shown between the detected episodes and thromboembolic events. Screening increases the detection rate without improving outcomes. Randomized trials (LOOP, NOAH-AFNET 6, ARTESiA) have not revealed any consistent clinical benefit from routine oral anticoagulation. In the ARTESiA trial, patients taking apixaban had fewer strokes (hazard ratio 0.63, 95% confidence interval [0.45; 0.88]), but also significantly more clinically relevant hemorrhages (HR 1.80 [1.26; 2.7]). In the NOAH-AFNET 6 trial, edoxaban was not found to have any benefit, but it did elevate the risk of bleeding.Conclusion Routine oral anticoagulation cannot currently be recommended for patients with subclinical atrial fibrillation. Important considerations for treatment decisions include the individual thromboembolic risk profile, the duration and burden of subclinical atrial fibrillation, and the reliability of the diagnosis. Current evidence suggests that subclinical atrial fibrillation is more likely to be a marker for underlying atrial cardiomyopathy than a direct precipitant of thromboembolic events.

AI.tldr: 综述显示，亚临床房颤（设备或可穿戴设备检出）虽使卒中风险升高约2–2.5倍，但随机试验（LOOP、NOAH-AFNET 6、ARTESiA）未能证实常规口服抗凝可带来净临床获益，目前不推荐对其常规抗凝。
AI.motivation: 临床上明确的房颤在德国估计影响逾180万人，而心脏植入设备与可穿戴设备正在无症状、无房颤病史人群中越来越多地检出房性心律失常，即所谓“亚临床房颤”。现有证据有限且部分不一致，此类检出是否具有医学意义、是否构成口服抗凝指征，尚不明确，是当前电生理与卒中预防实践中的关键决策缺口。
AI.method: 这是一篇叙述性综述，基于在 PubMed、Embase 和 Cochrane Library 中围绕亚临床房颤、心房高频事件（AHRE）及设备/可穿戴设备检出房颤所进行的选择性文献检索，纳入2005–2025年的相关文献；未设统一纳入排除标准、未做定量合并，终点涉及卒中/血栓栓塞风险、出血风险与筛查获益，证据主体为观察性研究与随机对照试验（LOOP、NOAH-AFNET 6、ARTESiA）。
AI.result: 观察性研究显示，设备检出的持续≥6分钟的房性发作使卒中风险升高2–2.5倍，其绝对风险仍低于临床显性房颤患者；且未证实检出发作与血栓栓塞事件之间存在直接因果或时间关系。筛查可提高检出率，但未改善临床结局。随机试验未显示常规口服抗凝的一致临床获益：ARTESiA 中阿哌沙班组卒中更少（HR 0.63，95%CI 0.45–0.88），但临床相关出血显著增多（HR 1.80，95%CI 1.26–2.7）；NOAH-AFNET 6 中艾多沙班无获益且增加出血风险。摘要未报告 LOOP 试验的具体效应量。
AI.conclusion: 目前不能推荐对亚临床房颤患者常规口服抗凝。治疗决策需综合个体血栓栓塞风险谱、亚临床房颤的持续时间与负荷以及诊断的可靠性。现有证据提示，亚临床房颤更可能是 underlying 心房心肌病的标志物，而非血栓栓塞事件的直接诱因；本文为叙述性综述，未提供定量合并结果，结论仍需以按房颤负荷分层的随机试验进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：据估计，德国有超过180万人受临床明显的心房颤动影响。心脏器械和可穿戴设备在没有任何心房颤动病史的无症状人群中越来越多地检出房性心律失常。此类病例通常被称为“亚临床心房颤动”。鉴于目前可获得的证据有限且部分不一致，尚不清楚这种情况是否具有医学意义、是否为口服抗凝治疗的指征。

方法：本综述基于2005—2025年在PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library数据库中围绕亚临床心房颤动、心房高频率事件（AHRE）以及器械或可穿戴设备检出的心房颤动进行选择性检索所得的相关文献。

结果：亚临床心房颤动与卒中风险升高相关，且该风险随发作持续时间和心律失常负荷的增加而升高。观察性研究显示，器械检出的持续6分钟或更长的发作可使卒中风险升高2至2.5倍，其绝对风险仍低于临床明显心房颤动患者。尚未证实所检出的发作与血栓栓塞事件之间存在直接的因果或时间关系。筛查可提高检出率，但未改善结局。随机试验（LOOP、NOAH-AFNET 6、ARTESiA）未显示常规口服抗凝治疗具有一致的临床获益。在ARTESiA试验中，服用阿哌沙班的患者卒中更少（风险比0.63，95%置信区间[0.45；0.88]），但临床相关出血也显著更多（HR 1.80 [1.26；2.7]）。在NOAH-AFNET 6试验中，未发现艾多沙班具有任何获益，但其确实升高了出血风险。

结论：目前尚不能推荐对亚临床心房颤动患者进行常规口服抗凝治疗。治疗决策的重要考虑因素包括个体血栓栓塞风险特征、亚临床心房颤动的持续时间和负荷，以及诊断的可靠性。现有证据提示，亚临床心房颤动更可能是潜在心房心肌病的标志物，而非血栓栓塞事件的直接诱因。

title: [Atrial fibrillation screening-reading the P-wave]
summary: Background Atrial fibrillation (AF) is frequently intermittent and may therefore remain undetected on a short resting electrocardiogram (ECG). At the same time, a sinus-rhythm ECG contains information on the underlying atrial substrate.Objective To review conventional and artificial intelligence (AI)-based ECG markers of an atrial risk phenotype and their potential role in targeted AF screening.Materials and methods Narrative appraisal of current consensus and guideline documents and of clinical, electrophysiological, and population-based studies on P‑wave parameters, AI-ECG, and risk-adapted AF screening.Results P‑wave duration, interatrial block, P‑wave terminal force in V1, and other parameters are associated with atrial remodelling and future AF. AI models additionally extract high-dimensional patterns from sinus-rhythm ECGs and can predict occult or future AF. Initial prospective data indicate that such risk signals can enrich the diagnostic yield of prolonged rhythm monitoring.Conclusion The most plausible current clinical application is risk-adapted selection for prolonged rhythm monitoring. A P-wave or AI-based risk score neither establishes a diagnosis of AF nor, by itself, constitutes an indication for treatment.

AI.tldr: 该综述指出，窦律心电图的P波参数与AI-ECG模型可识别房颤高危表型，用于风险适配性延长节律监测，但不能诊断房颤或单独构成治疗指征。
AI.motivation: 房颤常呈间歇性发作，短时静息心电图容易漏诊；而窦律心电图本身携带心房基质信息。既往证据对哪些传统及人工智能心电图标志物可构成心房风险表型、以及如何用于靶向房颤筛查仍缺乏系统梳理，本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，评估现行共识与指南文件，以及关于P波参数、AI-ECG和风险适配性房颤筛查的临床、电生理和人群研究。摘要未报告样本量、文献检索策略、终点定义及统计方法，未进行定量合并分析。
AI.result: P波时限、房间传导阻滞、V1导联P波终末力及其他P波参数与心房重构和未来房颤相关；AI模型可从窦律心电图提取高维模式，预测隐匿性或未来房颤。初步前瞻性数据提示，此类风险信号可提高延长节律监测的诊断产出。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 当前最合理的临床应用是依据P波或AI风险信号进行风险适配性选择，以决定是否延长节律监测；但P波或AI风险评分既不能确立房颤诊断，本身也不构成治疗指征。其价值在于提高筛查效率，仍需前瞻性验证并避免过度诊疗，且本文为叙述性综述，证据强度有限。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）常为阵发性，因此可能在短时静息心电图（ECG）上未被发现。同时，窦性心律心电图包含有关潜在心房基质的信息。

目的：综述传统及基于人工智能（AI）的心房风险表型心电图标志物及其在针对性AF筛查中的潜在作用。

材料与方法：对当前共识和指南文件，以及关于P波参数、AI-ECG和风险适应性AF筛查的临床、电生理和人群研究进行叙述性评价。

结果：P波时限、房间传导阻滞、V1导联P波终末力及其他参数与心房重构和未来AF相关。AI模型还可从窦性心律心电图中提取高维模式，并能预测隐匿性或未来AF。初步前瞻性数据表明，此类风险信号可提高延长节律监测的诊断率。

结论：目前最可能的临床应用是风险适应性选择以进行延长节律监测。基于P波或AI的风险评分既不能确立AF诊断，其本身也不构成治疗指征。

title: Procedural Efficiency and Clinical Outcomes of a Region-Specific Radiofrequency Ablation Strategy for Pulmonary Vein Isolation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: High-power short-duration radiofrequency ablation improves procedural efficiency during pulmonary vein isolation (PVI), but concerns remain regarding lesion transmurality and posterior wall collateral injury. We evaluated whether a region-specific ablation strategy was associated with improved procedural efficiency without a detected difference in acute efficacy or 12-month arrhythmia recurrence compared with conventional ablation index-guided PVI.

METHODS: In this retrospective single-center study, 250 patients undergoing first-time PVI were treated with either ablation index-guided ablation or a region-specific strategy using very high-power short-duration applications on the posterior wall and ablation index-guided lesions on the anterior wall. The primary endpoint was first-pass isolation, analyzed per pulmonary vein using generalized estimating equations to account for within-patient clustering. Secondary endpoints included procedural efficiency, peri-procedural safety, and 12-month arrhythmia recurrence.

RESULTS: First-pass isolation was achieved in 919 of 1 000 pulmonary veins (91.9%): 454 of 500 veins (90.8%) with the region-specific strategy and 465 of 500 veins (93.0%) with ablation index-guided ablation, with no significant between-group difference (OR, 0.74; 95% CI, 0.41-1.34; p = 0.322). The region-specific strategy was associated with shorter procedure duration, ablation time, radiofrequency time, fluoroscopy time, and lower radiation dose (all p < 0.001). Acute complications occurred in 4 patients (1.6%). At 12 months, arrhythmia recurrence occurred in 43 patients (17.2%), with no detected difference between strategies.

CONCLUSIONS: A region-specific ablation strategy improved procedural efficiency without a detected difference in first-pass isolation or 12-month arrhythmia recurrence compared with ablation index-guided PVI.

AI.tldr: 在首次 PVI 患者中，后壁采用极高功率短时程、前壁采用消融指数指导的区域特异性射频消融策略，与标准消融指数策略相比首过隔离率和 12 个月复发率无差异，但手术效率显著提高。
AI.motivation: 高功率短时程射频消融可提升 PVI 的手术效率，但临床仍担心其透壁性不足以及后壁邻近结构（如食管）的损伤风险。目前尚不清楚按解剖区域差异化设置消融参数（后壁极高功率短时程、前壁消融指数指导）能否在不损失急性隔离效果与长期疗效的前提下缩短手术时间、减少射线暴露。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，纳入 250 例首次接受 PVI 的患者，分为消融指数指导组与区域特异性策略组（后壁采用极高功率短时程消融，前壁采用消融指数指导消融）。主要终点为首过隔离，以肺静脉为单位分析，采用广义估计方程校正同一患者内多条肺静脉之间的聚类效应；次要终点包括手术效率指标（手术时长、消融时间、射频时间、透视时间、辐射剂量）、围术期安全性及 12 个月房性心律失常复发。
AI.result: 共 1 000 条肺静脉中 919 条（91.9%）实现首过隔离：区域特异性组 454/500 条（90.8%），消融指数组 465/500 条（93.0%），两组差异无统计学意义（OR 0.74，95%CI 0.41–1.34，P=0.322）。区域特异性策略组的手术时长、消融时间、射频时间、透视时间均更短，辐射剂量更低（均 P<0.001）。围术期并发症 4 例（1.6%）。12 个月随访时 43 例（17.2%）出现心律失常复发，两种策略之间未检测到差异。
AI.conclusion: 与消融指数指导的 PVI 相比，区域特异性消融策略可改善手术效率（缩短手术与透视时间、降低辐射剂量），且首过隔离率与 12 个月心律失常复发率未检测到差异。该结果支持按区域调整射频参数以兼顾效率与安全性，但作为回顾性单中心研究，样本量有限、未报告复发比较的具体效应量与置信区间，仍需前瞻性随机研究验证其对透壁性和长期疗效的真实影响。

title: Transient changes in P-wave terminal force after electrical cardioversion of persistent atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: P-wave terminal force in lead V1 (PWTFV1) reflects left atrial remodeling and is associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) outcomes, but its time course after electrical cardioversion of persistent AF is unclear.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 108 patients with persistent AF after successful electrical cardioversion, with 12‑lead electrocardiograms at 30 min, 1 month, and 3 months. Terminal P-wave duration (PNTV1) and amplitude (PNAV1) in lead V1 were measured and PWTFV1 calculated as their product; changes are expressed in absolute magnitude. Correlations with left atrial diameter and categorical classification (abnormal if magnitude ≥4000 ms·μV) were assessed.

RESULTS: PNTV1 increased at 1 month versus 30 min (60 ± 25 vs 58 ± 19 ms; P = 0.018) and returned to baseline at 3 months (57 ± 19 ms; P = 0.83; Friedman P = 0.031). PNAV1 was unchanged (P = 0.37). PWTFV1 increased transiently in magnitude at 1 month (-4294 ± 2545 vs -4079 ± 2138 ms·μV; P = 0.022) and normalized at 3 months (-4039 ± 2060 ms·μV; P = 0.64). PWTFV1 did not correlate with left atrial diameter (all |ρ| ≈ 0.05, P ≥ 0.61), and categorical classification was unchanged (57/108 abnormal throughout; no patient reclassified).

CONCLUSION: PWTFV1 shows transient, duration-driven variability after cardioversion, peaking at 1 month. The change is small, does not alter categorical classification, and is not mirrored by left atrial size, consistent with ongoing atrial recovery rather than stable remodeling. Timing of assessment matters when PWTFV1 is interpreted as a continuous measure.

AI.tldr: 108例持续性AF患者电复律后，V1导联P波终末电势在1个月时一过性增大、3个月恢复至基线；变化主要由P波终末时限驱动、幅度很小，不改变异常分类，也与左房内径无关。
AI.motivation: V1导联P波终末电势（PWTFV1）是反映左心房重构的指标，既往研究提示其与AF消融及复律后的结局相关，但持续性AF电复律成功后PWTFV1随时间的演变规律尚不清楚，临床在何时测量、如何解读连续测值缺乏依据。本研究旨在刻画复律后PWTFV1的时间曲线，并判断其变化究竟反映心房逆重构恢复过程，还是稳定的重构状态。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列分析，纳入108例持续性AF并成功行电复律的患者，分别在复律后30分钟、1个月、3个月记录12导联心电图，测量V1导联P波终末时限（PNTV1）与终末振幅（PNAV1），以两者乘积计算PWTFV1，变化以绝对值幅度表示；分析PWTFV1与左房内径的相关性，并按幅度≥4000 ms·μV定义为异常进行二分类比较。统计方法包括Friedman检验及组间两两比较，相关性以ρ表示；具体相关分析方法及随访完整率摘要未报告。
AI.result: PNTV1由复律后30分钟的58±19 ms升至1个月时的60±25 ms（P=0.018），3个月回落至57±19 ms（P=0.83），总体Friedman P=0.031；PNAV1无显著变化（P=0.37）。PWTFV1幅度在1个月时一过性增大（-4294±2545 vs -4079±2138 ms·μV，P=0.022），3个月恢复至-4039±2060 ms·μV（P=0.64）。PWTFV1与左房内径无相关（各时点|ρ|≈0.05，P≥0.61）；二分类结果全程不变（57/108例始终为异常，无1例发生分类转移）。
AI.conclusion: 持续性AF电复律后PWTFV1呈时限驱动的一过性波动，1个月达峰、3个月恢复，变化幅度小、不改变异常/正常的分类判断，且与左房内径变化不平行，更符合心房电学与机械功能仍在恢复过程，而非稳定的心房重构标志。临床意义在于：以PWTFV1作为连续变量进行风险分层或随访时需固定测量时点，复律后1个月内测值可能被高估。局限性为回顾性设计、样本量有限、随访仅3个月、摘要未报告AF复发及抗心律失常药物使用等混杂因素，PWTFV1变化与临床结局的关系尚待验证。

title: Outcomes of a Simplified Two-Catheter Approach for Catheter Ablation of SVT in Pediatric Patients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablations are an established treatment for supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) in pediatric patients with high success and low complication rates typically. This study evaluated the procedural outcomes, safety, and recurrence rates of pediatric patients undergoing SVT ablation using a two-catheter approach.

METHODS: A retrospective review was performed of 150 pediatric patients who underwent electrophysiology studies and catheter ablation for SVT. All patients were younger than 21 years, with arrhythmia mechanisms including atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT), ectopic atrial tachycardia (EAT), atrial flutter, and other accessory pathway-mediated tachycardias. All electrophysiology (EP) studies and catheter ablations were performed using a two-catheter access approach at the University of California at Davis by a sole operator with typically just a catheter in the coronary sinus and a second linear catheter (right atrial/ ventricular/ His) to start. All patients had follow-up of one year or if recurrence than 1 year from subsequent ablation.

RESULTS: Acute procedural success was achieved in all patients. The median age at the time of ablation was 13 years (IQR: 8-16 years). The median weight and height were 53.9 kg (IQR: 34.6-67.6 kg) and 157.3 cm (IQR: 137-170 cm), respectively. No intraprocedural complications were observed, including vascular access complications. Additionally, no postprocedural complications occurred, including pericardial effusion, cardiac tamponade, air embolism, thrombus formation, or heart block. Two patients experienced arrhythmia recurrence within 12 months of follow-up, corresponding to a recurrence rate of 1.3% and an overall success rate of 98.7%. Recurrence occurred in one patient with a Mahaim pathway and one patient with a left posterolateral accessory pathway.

CONCLUSION: A two-catheter access approach may be safely performed with good short-and medium-term outcomes in pediatric patients.

AI.tldr: 单中心150例21岁以下SVT患儿采用两根导管简化入路行电生理检查与消融，急性成功率100%、无任何围术期并发症，12个月内复发率仅1.3%，总体成功率98.7%。
AI.motivation: 导管消融已是儿童室上性心动过速（SVT）的成熟治疗手段，总体成功率高、并发症低，但传统操作常需多根导管（含右房、右室、希氏束、冠状窦及消融导管）以完成标测与诊断。减少导管数量有望缩短手术与透视时间、降低血管通路相关风险及低体重患儿的辐射暴露，然而关于简化“两导管”入路在儿童SVT中有效性、安全性与复发率的数据仍有限。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入美国加州大学戴维斯分校由同一术者完成的150例SVT患儿（均<21岁），心律失常机制包括房室结折返性心动过速（AVNRT）、异位房性心动过速（EAT）、心房扑动及其他旁路介导的心动过速。全部电生理检查与消融均采用两导管入路：通常一根置于冠状窦，另一根为右房/右室/希氏束线性导管，必要时再加消融导管。随访至少1年（若复发则随访至再次消融后1年）。主要观察指标为急性手术成功率、术中及术后并发症与12个月内复发率。摘要未报告具体的统计学检验方法。
AI.result: 全部患者均获急性手术成功（100%）。消融时中位年龄13岁（IQR 8–16岁），中位体重53.9 kg（IQR 34.6–67.6 kg），中位身高157.3 cm（IQR 137–170 cm）。术中无并发症，包括无血管穿刺相关并发症；术后亦无并发症，如心包积液、心包填塞、空气栓塞、血栓形成或心脏传导阻滞。随访12个月内2例复发，复发率1.3%，总体成功率98.7%；复发者分别为1例Mahaim旁路和1例左后外侧旁路。摘要未报告效应量的95%置信区间及组间比较的P值。
AI.conclusion: 对儿童SVT患者，两导管入路行电生理检查与消融可获得良好的短期与中期结局，且在所选病例中未见血管通路或心包相关并发症，提示简化导管策略在儿童人群具有可行性。但本研究为单中心、单术者、回顾性设计，样本量150例，缺乏与常规多导管入路的对照，结果外推需谨慎；复发集中在Mahaim旁路及左后外侧旁路等复杂旁路，此类患儿是否仍应选用简化入路尚需前瞻性对照研究验证。

title: Building a surgical atrial fibrillation program: Programmatic evolution, safety, and three-year rhythm outcomes of hybrid ablation.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Surgical ablation is a guideline-supported treatment for symptomatic persistent and long standing persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) refractory to catheter ablation, but how a program is built, refined, and sustained has not been described. We sought to describe the development of a de novo surgical ablation program as well as its procedural evolution, safety profile, and long-term rhythm outcomes.

METHODS: We reviewed the programmatic evolution of our program and growth of procedural volume and complexity. We also analyzed the long-term electrophysiologic and safety outcomes of all patients undergoing minimally invasive surgical ablation from 2020 to 2024. Rhythm assessment was performed using 12 lead ECG, wearable monitor, implantable loop recorder, or ICD/PPM interrogation following a 3-month blanking period after endocardial ablation.

RESULTS: One hundred and twenty-five consecutive patients undergoing hybrid surgical ablation between 2020 and 2024 at our institution were analyzed. Of which, one hundred and twelve had sufficient follow-up data. At 1, 2, and 3 years of follow-up, 94%, 85%, and 70% of patients were in normal sinus rhythm with 67% of those patients remaining off class I/III antiarrhythmic therapy at three years. There were no peri-procedural deaths, conversions to sternotomy, tamponade, strokes, or atrio-esophageal fistulae. Thirty-day adverse events occurred in 4 patients (3.6%) and included three patients with pericarditis and one patient with transient phrenic nerve palsy. The volume at our institution increased fourfold during the study period paralleled by increasing complexity and scope of operations.

CONCLUSIONS: This experience provides a roadmap for developing a multifaceted hybrid ablation program with excellent safety and durable rhythm outcomes.

AI.tldr: 单中心 125 例连续性杂交外科消融队列显示，术后 1、2、3 年正常窦性心律比例分别为 94%、85%、70%，3 年时 67% 的患者停用 I/III 类抗心律失常药；30 天不良事件仅 3.6%，无围术期死亡、转胸骨、心脏压塞、卒中或心房食管瘘。
AI.motivation: 外科消融是指南支持的治疗手段，适用于症状性持续性和长程持续性 AF、且导管消融失败的患者，但一个外科消融项目如何从零建立、逐步调整并长期维持，既往文献从未描述；同时，杂交消融的长期心律结局与安全性证据仍有限。本研究旨在报告一个新建外科消融项目的项目化发展路径、术式演变、安全性和 3 年心律结局。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性项目经验总结，同时分析 2020—2024 年全部接受微创杂交外科消融（外科心外膜消融+导管心内膜标测消融）的连续性患者的长期电生理与安全性结局。共 125 例，其中 112 例随访资料充分。心律评估在内膜消融后 3 个月空白期之后，采用 12 导联心电图、可穿戴监测、植入式循环记录仪或 ICD/起搏器程控检查。终点为窦性心律维持率、停用 I/III 类抗心律失常药比例及围术期/30 天不良事件；摘要未报告具体统计方法及置信区间。
AI.result: 随访 1、2、3 年时，分别有 94%、85%、70% 的患者维持正常窦性心律，3 年时其中 67% 未使用 I/III 类抗心律失常药。安全性方面无围术期死亡、无中转胸骨切开、无心脏压塞、卒中及心房食管瘘；30 天不良事件 4 例（3.6%），包括 3 例心包炎和 1 例短暂性膈神经麻痹。研究期间本中心手术量增长约 4 倍，同时术式复杂程度与手术范围同步提升。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI 及 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 该单中心经验提示，分阶段构建的多学科杂交消融项目可在保证极低围术期风险的前提下获得较持久的窦性心律维持率，为拟开展外科消融的中心提供了可复制的项目化路线图。局限性包括样本量有限、回顾性设计、无对照组、心律监测手段异质（心电图为间歇性监测，可能高估或低估复发），且为单中心高流量团队经验，外推性需多中心前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
目的：外科消融是指南支持的治疗方法，适用于经导管消融仍难治的症状性持续性及长程持续性心房颤动（AF），但如何建立、完善并维持一个项目尚未见描述。我们旨在描述一个新建外科消融项目的发展，以及其术式演变、安全性和长期节律结局。

方法：我们回顾了本项目的项目演进以及手术量和复杂程度的增长。我们还分析了2020年至2024年所有接受微创外科消融患者的长期电生理和安全结局。心内膜消融后3个月空白期后，采用12导联心电图、可穿戴监测器、植入式循环记录器或ICD/PPM程控查询进行节律评估。

结果：分析了2020年至2024年间在本机构连续接受杂交外科消融的125例患者。其中112例有足够的随访数据。在随访1年、2年和3年时，94%、85%和70%的患者处于正常窦性心律，其中67%的患者在3年时仍未使用I/III类抗心律失常药物治疗。无围术期死亡、中转胸骨切开、心脏压塞、卒中或心房食管瘘。30天不良事件发生于4例患者（3.6%），包括3例心包炎和1例短暂性膈神经麻痹。研究期间本机构的手术量增加了四倍，同时手术复杂程度和范围也不断增加。

结论：这一经验为建立具有极佳安全性和持久节律结局的多层面杂交消融项目提供了路线图。

title: Relationship between paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and the Osaka Prognostic Score.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The Osaka Prognostic Score (OPS), which is based on C‑reactive protein (CRP), total lymphocyte count (TLC), and albumin (ALB), has been reported to have prognostic value in several types of cancer. Recent studies have revealed a relationship between the OPS and cardiovascular diseases. The aim of this study was to evaluate the relationship between the OPS and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF), a significant rhythm disorder.

METHODS: A total of 941 individuals, including 198 patients with a history of AF and 743 patients without AF as the control group, were included in the study. These groups were compared in terms of demographic characteristics and laboratory findings.

RESULTS: Univariable and multivariable binary logistic regression analyses revealed an independent relationship between the OPS and AF (odds ratio [OR]: 3.37, p < 0.001). In receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, OPS above a cut-off level of 0.5 was associated with the presence of AF, with a sensitivity of 55.6% and a specificity of 77.4% (area under the ROC curve [AUC]: 0.682, p < 0.001).

CONCLUSION: This study found a relationship between the OPS and paroxysmal AF attacks. The OPS may provide additional information for the clinical evaluation of patients with paroxysmal AF in daily practice.

AI.tldr: 在941例受试者中，大阪预后评分（OPS）与阵发性房颤独立相关（OR 3.37），但区分度仅中等（AUC 0.682）。
AI.motivation: OPS由CRP、总淋巴细胞计数和白蛋白构成，已在多种肿瘤中显示预后价值，近年发现与心血管疾病相关；但其与阵发性AF的关系尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 本研究纳入941例受试者，其中198例有AF病史、743例无AF作为对照，比较人口学特征和实验室指标；采用单变量及多变量二元logistic回归分析OPS与AF的关系，并用ROC曲线评估诊断性能。摘要未报告研究设计细节、OPS具体计分方法及多变量调整变量。
AI.result: 单变量和多变量二元logistic回归均显示OPS与AF存在独立关系（OR 3.37，P<0.001；摘要未报告95%CI及具体调整因素）。ROC分析中，OPS>0.5与AF存在相关，敏感度55.6%、特异度77.4%，AUC 0.682（P<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: OPS与阵发性房颤发作相关，可能为临床评估提供补充信息；但AUC提示区分度中等，且研究设计不能推断因果，作为AF筛查或诊断工具仍需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：大阪预后评分（OPS）基于C反应蛋白（CRP）、总淋巴细胞计数（TLC）和白蛋白（ALB），已被报道在多种癌症中具有预后价值。近期研究揭示了OPS与心血管疾病之间的关系。本研究旨在评估OPS与阵发性心房颤动（AF）——一种重要的心律失常——之间的关系。

方法：本研究共纳入941例个体，包括198例有AF病史的患者和743例无AF的患者作为对照组。比较这些组别的人口学特征和实验室检查结果。

结果：单变量和多变量二元logistic回归分析显示，OPS与AF之间存在独立关系（比值比[OR]：3.37，p < 0.001）。在受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析中，OPS高于0.5的截断水平与AF的存在相关，敏感性为55.6%，特异性为77.4%（ROC曲线下面积[AUC]：0.682，p < 0.001）。

结论：本研究发现OPS与阵发性AF发作之间存在关系。OPS可能为日常实践中阵发性AF患者的临床评估提供额外信息。

title: Integrated care management and comprehensive geriatric assessment using a mHealth-based approach in older multimorbid patients with atrial fibrillation: the AFFIRMO cluster-randomised trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The AFFIRMO trial aimed to evaluate the efficacy of a mobile-health (mHealth) structured intervention adapting the Atrial Fibrillation Better Care (ABC) pathway, combining the comprehensive geriatric assessment (CGA), to enhance guideline-directed, holistic AF management and reduce the risk of clinical outcomes in older patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and multimorbidity.

METHODS: In a multicentre, open-label, cluster-randomised study conducted in six European countries, clusters were allocated to usual care or intervention (iABC system) (ClinicalTrials.govNCT06775028, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06775028). In usual care clusters, patients were managed according to clinical guidelines.

FINDINGS: We enrolled 1260 patients (mean [SD] age 74 [6] years; 44.4% (560/1260) female; median CHA2DS2-VASc 4 [IQR 3-5]), with 634 (50.3%) assigned to intervention and 626 (49.7%) to usual care. Overall, 41.0% (517/1260) had >2 comorbidities, with a high prevalence of anticoagulation (1226, 97.3%) and guideline-recommended therapies. CGA in the intervention arm documented a highly preserved function. The primary endpoint of all-cause unplanned hospitalisation occurred in 108 (17.1%) and 114 (18.2%) patients in the intervention and usual care groups [adjusted OR 0.95, 95% CI 0.61-1.49; p = 0.84]. Use of the AFFIRMO Mobile App was suboptimal, with 68.5% (433/632) of patients using it for only one-third of the observation time.

INTERPRETATION: In a setting of high baseline guideline adherence and low event rates, the iABC system did not reduce unplanned hospitalisations compared with usual care. These findings suggest no incremental benefit of mHealth integrated care interventions when applied to optimally managed populations, particularly in the context of suboptimal intervention uptake.

FUNDING: European Union's Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation Program (grant agreement 899871).

AI.tldr: 在1260例平均74岁的多病共存AF患者中，基于mHealth并整合CGA的ABC路径干预未能降低全因非计划住院（17.1% vs 18.2%，校正OR 0.95，95%CI 0.61-1.49，P=0.84）。
AI.motivation: 老年AF患者常合并多种慢性病，指南推荐的ABC（Atrial Fibrillation Better Care）综合管理路径虽被提倡，但如何在老年多病共存人群中落地实施尚缺乏高质量证据；mHealth工具能否在结构化整合照护中叠加综合老年评估（CGA）并改善硬终点，既往缺乏多中心随机对照验证。
AI.method: 多中心、开放标签、整群随机对照试验（AFFIRMO，NCT06775028），在6个欧洲国家开展，整群随机分配至常规照护组或iABC干预组（基于移动健康的ABC路径+CGA结构化干预）。共纳入1260例老年AF合并多病患者，平均年龄74（SD 6）岁，女性44.4%（560/1260），CHA2DS2-VASc中位数4（IQR 3-5）；干预组634例（50.3%），常规照护组626例（49.7%）。主要终点为全因非计划住院，采用校正OR比较组间差异。
AI.result: 整体41.0%（517/1260）患者合并>2种共病，基线抗凝率高达97.3%（1226例），指南推荐治疗使用率高；干预组CGA显示功能状态保存良好。主要终点全因非计划住院在干预组发生108例（17.1%）、常规照护组114例（18.2%），校正OR 0.95（95%CI 0.61-1.49），P=0.84，无统计学差异。干预依从性不佳：68.5%（433/632）的患者仅在观察时间的1/3内使用AFFIRMO移动应用。次要终点及安全性数据摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在基线指南依从性高、事件发生率低的人群中，iABC系统较常规照护并未减少非计划住院，提示对已获优化管理的AF人群，mHealth整合照护干预的增量获益有限；同时干预摄入不足（应用使用率低）可能稀释了潜在效应。该结果不支持在类似高质量照护体系中常规推广此类mHealth整合管理模式，未来研究需聚焦依从性提升与高危、管理欠佳人群的筛选；本研究为开放标签设计、事件率低于预期且缺乏盲法，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
背景：AFFIRMO试验旨在评估一种移动健康（mHealth）结构化干预的疗效，该干预对心房颤动更好照护（ABC）路径进行适配，并结合综合老年评估（CGA），以加强遵循指南的整体性AF管理，并降低患有心房颤动（AF）且多病共存的老年患者的临床结局风险。

方法：在这项在六个欧洲国家开展的多中心、开放标签、整群随机研究中，各整群被分配至常规诊疗或干预（iABC系统）（ClinicalTrials.govNCT06775028，https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06775028）。在常规诊疗整群中，患者按临床指南进行管理。

结果：我们纳入1260例患者（平均[SD]年龄74[6]岁；44.4%（560/1260）为女性；CHA2DS2-VASc中位数4[IQR 3-5]），其中634例（50.3%）分配至干预组，626例（49.7%）分配至常规诊疗组。总体而言，41.0%（517/1260）有>2种合并症，抗凝治疗（1226，97.3%）和指南推荐治疗的使用率很高。干预组的CGA显示功能状态高度保留。主要终点全因非计划住院在干预组和常规诊疗组分别发生于108例（17.1%）和114例（18.2%）患者[校正OR 0.95，95% CI 0.61-1.49；p = 0.84]。AFFIRMO移动应用程序的使用欠佳，68.5%（433/632）的患者使用该应用的时间仅占观察时间的三分之一。

解读：在基线指南依从性高且事件发生率低的背景下，与常规诊疗相比，iABC系统未减少非计划住院。这些发现提示，当mHealth整合照护干预应用于已得到最佳管理的人群时没有额外获益，尤其是在干预接受度欠佳的情况下。

资助：欧盟“地平线2020”研究与创新计划（资助协议899871）。

title: Barriers and Facilitators to the Initiation of Home-Based Exercise Rehabilitation After Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A TDF-Based Qualitative Study.
summary:
PURPOSE: Home-based exercise rehabilitation is important for recovery after atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. However, the barriers and facilitators influencing the initiation of home-based exercise rehabilitation during the early post-ablation recovery phase remain insufficiently understood. This study aimed to explore the barriers and facilitators influencing the initiation of home-based exercise rehabilitation among patients following radiofrequency catheter ablation for AF, guided by the Theoretical Domains Framework (TDF).

PATIENTS AND METHODS: A descriptive qualitative study was conducted using purposive sampling. Twenty patients who had undergone radiofrequency catheter ablation for AF were recruited from a tertiary general hospital in Jiangsu Province, China. Formal data collection was conducted from August to December 2025.Face-to-face semi-structured interviews were conducted individually during routine follow-up approximately one month after ablation. The phenomenon under investigation was the initiation of home-based exercise rehabilitation during the early recovery phase, referring to patients' transition toward intentional, planned exercise activities performed at home after discharge and recommended or guided by healthcare professionals. Data were analysed using qualitative content analysis with a hybrid inductive-deductive approach informed by the TDF.

RESULTS: Factors influencing the initiation of home-based exercise rehabilitation were categorized into promoting and impeding factors. A total of 11 influencing factors were identified: 3 promoting factors (benefit-driven motivation, trust and recognition of professionals, and family responsibility as a motivator) and 8 impeding factors (lack of exercise knowledge, inadequate skill mastery, low exercise self-efficacy, distress from physical symptoms, poor resource accessibility, negative emotional distress, and absence of exercise plans).

CONCLUSION: The initiation of home-based exercise rehabilitation after radiofrequency catheter ablation for AF is influenced by multiple interacting individual, professional, and contextual factors. Support strategies should address patients' knowledge and skills, confidence, symptom-related concerns, access to professional guidance and rehabilitation resources, and competing social responsibilities to facilitate the initiation of home-based exercise rehabilitation during early recovery.

AI.tldr: 基于TDF框架的质性研究纳入20例房颤射频消融术后患者，识别出影响居家运动康复启动的11个因素（3个促进、8个阻碍），核心阻碍为运动知识技能不足、自我效能低与缺乏康复方案。
AI.motivation: 居家运动康复对房颤消融术后恢复具有重要价值，但术后早期（出院后至随访约1个月）患者从被动休养转向有意图、有计划的居家运动这一启动环节，其阻碍与促进因素尚缺乏系统认识；既往研究多为依从性横断面调查，缺少理论框架指导下的机制性解释，难以指导针对性支持策略的设计。
AI.method: 描述性质性研究，采用目的抽样，自江苏省一家三级综合医院招募20例接受房颤射频导管消融的患者，正式资料收集时间为2025年8月至12月；于术后约1个月常规随访时进行一对一面对面半结构化访谈。研究现象定义为出院后、在医务人员推荐或指导下于家中启动有意图、有计划的运动康复。以理论域框架（TDF）为指导，采用归纳—演绎相结合的质性内容分析法分析资料。摘要未报告访谈时长、饱和标准及研究者三角验证等细节。
AI.result: 影响因素被归纳为促进因素与阻碍因素两类，共11个：促进因素3个（获益驱动的动机、对专业人员的信任与认可、家庭责任作为激励）；阻碍因素8个（缺乏运动知识、技能掌握不足、运动自我效能低、躯体症状带来的困扰、康复资源可及性差、负性情绪困扰、缺乏运动计划）——摘要列举的阻碍条目仅7项，与所述8个不一致，原文未作说明；摘要亦未报告各因素的例数分布、引文证据及促进/阻碍因素间的交互关系。
AI.conclusion: 房颤射频消融术后居家运动康复的启动受个体、专业与情境多个层面因素交互影响。后续干预应在术后早期针对性提升患者的运动知识与技能、增强信心、处理症状相关顾虑、改善专业指导与康复资源的可及性，并协调家庭与社会责任冲突。本研究为单中心小样本质性研究，结果可迁移性有限，且未与康复启动行为或临床结局建立量化关联，仍需量性验证与干预性研究。

summary_zh:
目的：居家运动康复对房颤（AF）消融术后恢复具有重要意义。然而，影响消融术后早期恢复阶段启动居家运动康复的阻碍因素与促进因素仍认识不足。本研究以理论域框架（TDF）为指导，旨在探讨影响房颤射频导管消融术后患者启动居家运动康复的阻碍因素与促进因素。

患者与方法：采用目的抽样开展描述性定性研究。从中国江苏省一家三级综合医院招募了20例接受房颤射频导管消融术的患者。正式资料收集于2025年8月至12月进行。在术后约1个月的常规随访期间，逐一进行面对面半结构化访谈。所研究的现象为早期恢复阶段居家运动康复的启动，指患者出院后在医疗专业人员的推荐或指导下，转向在家中进行有意图、有计划的运动活动。资料采用定性内容分析，并结合受TDF启发的归纳-演绎混合方法进行分析。

结果：影响居家运动康复启动的因素被归类为促进因素和阻碍因素。共识别出11个影响因素：3个促进因素（获益驱动的动机、对专业人员的信任与认可、以及作为激励因素的家庭责任）和8个阻碍因素（缺乏运动知识、技能掌握不足、运动自我效能低、躯体症状带来的痛苦、资源可及性差、负性情绪困扰以及缺乏运动计划）。

结论：房颤射频导管消融术后居家运动康复的启动受多个相互作用的个体、专业和环境因素影响。支持策略应针对患者的知识与技能、信心、症状相关担忧、获得专业指导和康复资源的途径以及相互竞争的社会责任，以促进早期恢复阶段居家运动康复的启动。

title: Ventricular Arrhythmias in Marfan Syndrome: Prevalence and Clinical Correlates in a Multicenter Cohort.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Ventricular arrhythmias are increasingly recognized in Marfan syndrome, but associated clinical and structural features remain incompletely defined.

METHODS: We performed a retrospective multicenter cohort study of 783 adults with confirmed Marfan syndrome at 3 Mayo Clinic sites. Clinical, arrhythmic, echocardiographic, cardiac magnetic resonance, surgical, and implantable cardioverter defibrillator data were obtained by manual chart review. Associations with sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT) or ventricular fibrillation (VF) were evaluated using univariable logistic regression, a primary multivariable model in the full cohort, and a prespecified exploratory cardiac magnetic resonance sensitivity model.

RESULTS: Sustained VT/VF occurred in 74 patients (9.5%) over 12.7±7.6 years. On univariable analysis, sustained VT/VF clustered with an adverse structural-electrical phenotype including atrial arrhythmias, ventricular remodeling, mitral valve disease, cardiac surgery history, and late gadolinium enhancement. In the primary multivariable model, nonsustained VT (odds ratio, 12.11 [95% CI, 6.43-22.79]; P<0.001), lower left ventricular ejection fraction (odds ratio, 0.95 per 1% increase [95% CI, 0.93-0.97]; P<0.001), history of at least 1 cardiac surgery (odds ratio, 3.59 [95% CI, 1.65-7.84]; P=0.001), and moderate-severe mitral regurgitation (odds ratio, 2.00 [95% CI, 1.07-3.75]; P=0.030) were independently associated with sustained VT/VF. In the cardiac magnetic resonance sensitivity model, nonsustained VT, lower left ventricular ejection fraction, and late gadolinium enhancement remained associated with sustained VT/VF.

CONCLUSIONS: In adults with Marfan syndrome, sustained VT/VF occurs in nearly 1 in 10 patients and is associated with a broader structural-electrical phenotype. Late gadolinium enhancement provided additional risk signal among patients undergoing cardiac magnetic resonance.

title: Trends and Demographic Disparities Among Adults With Sudden Cardiac Death and Diabetes Mellitus in the United States: A Nationwide Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) represents a major cause of cardiovascular mortality, with diabetes mellitus (DM) significantly increasing susceptibility. However, long-term national trends and demographic disparities in SCD among decedents with co-documented SCD and DM remain insufficiently characterized.

METHODS: We conducted a retrospective analysis using the CDC WONDER database from 1999 to 2020. Adults with SCD and DM listed on death certificates were included. Age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMRs) per 100 000 population were calculated and stratified by sex, age group, race/ethnicity, census region, state, and urbanization status. Temporal trends were assessed using annual percent changes (APCs), with p < 0.05 considered statistically significant.

RESULTS: A total of 51 756 deaths among decedents with co-documented SCD and DM were identified. Overall AAMR increased from 1.29 in 1999 to 1.46 in 2020 (APC +0.46%, p = 0.012). Men had significantly higher mortality than women. Older adults (≥ 75 years) exhibited the highest mortality burden, though relative increases were notable in younger groups. Black individuals had the highest mortality, with a sharp rise in 2020. Rural populations experienced higher mortality than urban counterparts, with significant upward trends. Southern states demonstrated the highest regional burden.

CONCLUSION: The population-level burden of co-documented SCD and DM in the United States has increased modestly over the past two decades, with significant demographic and geographic disparities. Targeted public health interventions and equitable cardiovascular risk management are urgently needed to reduce these disparities.

title: Multimodality Cardiovascular Imaging in the Evaluation of Cardiac Sarcoidosis
summary: Cardiac sarcoidosis (CS) is a granulomatous disease associated with increased cardiovascular risk, including symptomatic high-grade atrioventricular block, ventricular arrhythmia, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death. Diagnosis can be challenging and requires a high index of suspicion. Although endomyocardial biopsy demonstrating noncaseating granulomas can diagnose CS with high specificity, sampling error leads to low sensitivity. CS is typically diagnosed using a combination of clinical criteria and advanced cardiac imaging, such as cardiac magnetic resonance and positron emission tomography, which can detect myocardial inflammation and fibrosis seen in CS. Recent advances in cardiac magnetic resonance and positron emission tomography have not only substantially improved the diagnosis of CS, but have also improved prognostic assessment, monitoring of treatment response, and guidance of other clinical decision-making, such as immunosuppressive and device therapy. Advanced cardiac imaging has been incorporated into recent international guidelines on inflammatory heart disease, and holds great promise to reshape contemporary clinical care for patients with CS.

AI.tldr: 多模态心脏影像（心脏磁共振与PET）可无创识别心脏结节病的心肌炎症与纤维化，不仅显著提高诊断准确性，还改善预后分层、疗效监测及免疫抑制与器械治疗决策，并已被纳入近期炎症性心脏病国际指南。
AI.motivation: 心脏结节病是肉芽肿性疾病，可导致有症状的高级别房室阻滞、室性心律失常、心力衰竭和心脏性猝死，心血管风险显著升高。其诊断具有挑战性，需高度临床怀疑：心内膜心肌活检虽特异性高，但因肉芽肿分布不均的采样误差导致敏感性低，临床上多依赖临床标准联合心脏磁共振与PET等先进影像。既往证据的缺口在于如何将影像学从单纯“协助诊断”拓展到预后评估、治疗反应监测与器械治疗决策，并明确其在指南中的地位。
AI.method: 本文为综述（非原创临床研究），摘要未报告研究人群、样本量、随机化或分组干预，亦未报告终点定义与统计方法。文章系统梳理心脏磁共振（如延迟钆增强评估纤维化、T2及参数标测评估心肌水肿）与正电子发射断层显像（如18F-FDG显像识别活动性炎症、灌注显像识别瘢痕）在心脏结节病中的应用价值，涵盖诊断、预后判断、免疫抑制治疗反应监测，以及抗心律失常药物、植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）与心脏再同步治疗等器械决策的指导作用，并总结其在近期炎症性心脏病国际指南中的推荐情况。
AI.result: 摘要为定性叙述，未报告任何具体效应量、敏感度/特异度数值、95%置信区间或P值（摘要未报告）。可确认的关键表述为：心内膜心肌活检特异性高但敏感性低；心脏磁共振与PET能够检测心脏结节病特征性的心肌炎症与纤维化；近期影像技术进步不仅显著改善诊断，也改善了预后评估、治疗反应监测及其他临床决策（包括免疫抑制治疗与器械治疗）；先进心脏影像已被纳入近期炎症性心脏病国际指南。
AI.conclusion: 多模态心脏影像已成为心脏结节病诊断与全程管理的核心工具，并有望重塑该类患者的当代临床路径，对电生理实践的意义在于：通过识别活动性炎症与瘢痕负荷，辅助判断室性心律失常风险、筛选ICD植入对象并评估免疫抑制疗效。局限性在于本文为叙述性综述，摘要未提供量化诊断效能、预后阈值或前瞻性对照证据，影像方案与判读标准在不同中心间的可重复性、以及影像指导器械决策的成本效益仍待专门研究验证。

summary_zh: 心脏结节病（CS）是一种肉芽肿性疾病，与心血管风险增加相关，包括症状性高度房室传导阻滞、室性心律失常、心力衰竭和心源性猝死。其诊断具有挑战性，需要高度的临床怀疑指数。尽管心内膜心肌活检显示非干酪样肉芽肿可以高特异性诊断CS，但采样误差导致其敏感性较低。CS通常通过临床标准与先进心脏影像学（如心脏磁共振和正电子发射断层扫描）相结合来诊断，这些技术能够检测CS中所见的心肌炎症和纤维化。心脏磁共振和正电子发射断层扫描的近期进展不仅显著提高了CS的诊断水平，还改善了预后评估、治疗反应监测以及其他临床决策的指导，例如免疫抑制治疗和器械治疗。先进的心脏影像学已被纳入近期关于炎症性心脏病的国际指南，并有望重塑CS患者的当代临床管理。

title: The medial septum model as a pacemaker of theta rhythm: the key role of short-term synaptic plasticity.
summary: The hippocampal theta rhythm is crucial for memory and navigation. It is paced by parvalbumin-expressing GABAergic neurons in the medial septum. These neurons segregate into two subpopulations-Teevra and Komal cells-which fire in anti-phase bursts at theta frequency, with a stable phase shift of approximately 150 degrees, and exhibit mutual inhibition. While essential, the network mechanism enabling this stable anti-phase synchronization remains unresolved, as previous models relying on intrinsic neuronal adaptation or external rhythmic inputs conflict with experimental evidence. Here, we propose a novel computational model demonstrating that short-term synaptic depression (STD) within the reciprocal inhibitory circuit between these populations is sufficient to generate and stabilize the observed anti-phase theta oscillations. The model consists of two homogeneous populations of fast-spiking (Izhikevich model) neurons, connected via depressing synapses governed by Tsodyks-Markram dynamics. Using numerical simulation and optimization, we identify parameter regimes that robustly produce oscillations with the target 150-degree phase lag. Our analysis reveals that the balance of synaptic strengths is critical for initiating collective rhythmicity, while the time constants of neurotransmitter recovery ([Formula: see text]) and facilitation ([Formula: see text]) primarily control the precise phase relationship. The model reproduces key experimental features: sharp transitions to rhythmic states, frequency in the 4-5 Hz theta band, and independent control of oscillation amplitude and frequency by external excitatory drive and synaptic weights. The rhythm is stable over a wide parameter range, with frequency increasing with external drive but decreasing with stronger synaptic coupling. We conclude that STD provides a parsimonious and biologically plausible negative feedback mechanism to stabilize anti-phase pacing in the medial septum, effectively explaining the endogenous generation of hippocampal theta rhythm without requiring intrinsic pacemaking or phasic external inputs. This work highlights the fundamental role of network dynamics and short-term plasticity in producing critical brain rhythms.

AI.tldr: 计算模型显示，内侧隔区 Teevra 与 Komal 细胞相互抑制环路中的短时程突触抑制（STD）足以产生并稳定约 150° 反相 theta 振荡，无需内在起搏或外源节律输入。
AI.motivation: 海马 theta 节律对记忆与导航至关重要，由内侧隔区表达小清蛋白（parvalbumin）的 GABA 能神经元起搏。这群神经元分为 Teevra 与 Komal 两个亚群，二者以 theta 频率反相爆发、相位差稳定在约 150°，并彼此相互抑制。由于既往模型依赖神经元内在适应或外部节律性输入，与实验证据相矛盾，因此使这种稳定反相同步得以实现的网络机制仍未阐明。
AI.method: 本研究为计算建模研究，非人体或临床研究，样本量摘要未报告。模型由两群同质快速放电神经元（Izhikevich 模型）构成，两群之间经 Tsodyks-Markram 短时程抑制性突触连接。研究采用数值模拟与参数优化，筛选可稳健产生目标 150° 相位差的参数区间，并考察突触强度平衡、神经递质恢复时间常数（τrec）与易化时间常数（τfac）对相位关系的控制作用；观察指标包括相位差、振荡频率（4–5 Hz theta 频段）以及振幅与频率的调控方式。摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 模型在广泛参数范围内稳健产生反相振荡，相位差达到目标的 150°。分析显示：突触强度平衡是能否启动集体节律的关键，而 τrec 与 τfac 主要决定精确的相位关系。模型复现了多项关键实验特征：向节律状态的陡峭转变、4–5 Hz 的 theta 频段频率，以及外部兴奋驱动与突触权重对振荡振幅和频率的独立控制。频率随外部驱动增强而升高、随突触耦合增强而降低。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI 或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 短时程突触抑制提供了一种简洁且生物学合理的负反馈机制，可稳定内侧隔区的反相起搏，从而解释海马 theta 节律的内源性产生，无需内在起搏机制或相位性外部输入；这提示网络动力学与短时程可塑性在关键脑节律产生中具有基础性作用。局限性：本工作为纯计算模型，参数来自数值模拟与优化，尚缺乏在体电生理或临床记录验证；摘要未报告与器械治疗或临床电生理实践直接相关的转化数据。

title: Neurological Dysfunction During Contemporary Magnetically Levitated Left Ventricular Assist Device Support for Advanced Heart Failure: An STS-INTERMACS Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The burden of neurological dysfunction during contemporary magnetically levitated (Mag-Lev) left ventricular assist device (LVAD) support for advanced heart failure is uncertain.

OBJECTIVES: The objectives were to determine the incidence, prognosis, and risk factors of stroke and nonstroke neurological adverse events (NAEs) during Mag-Lev LVAD support.

METHODS: A retrospective cohort study using the multicenter U.S.-based Society of Thoracic Surgeons INTERMACS database was performed from January 1, 2017, to March 31, 2023. The study population comprised patients with heart failure on Mag-Lev LVAD support. The primary outcome was survival on Mag-Lev LVAD support. Multivariable Cox regression was used, with stroke and nonstroke NAE status as a time-varying covariate to determine the risk of death in comparison to no NAE. Separate multivariable Cox regression models were built to determine factors associated with death after stroke and nonstroke NAEs and to determine baseline clinical variables associated with the occurrence of stroke and nonstroke NAE.

RESULTS: Within 11,739 patients, 879 (8%) had a stroke, 972 (8%) experienced a nonstroke NAE, and 9,888 (84%) did not have a NAE over a median of 1.4 years (Q1-Q3: 0.5-2.7 years). At 2 years, survival on Mag-Lev LVAD support after stroke and nonstroke NAE was 45% and 56%, respectively (P < 0.001). In comparison to no NAE, the risk of death was elevated after stroke (HR: 7.3) and nonstroke NAE (HR: 5.1). Older age (HR: 1.02 per year), pre-LVAD implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (HR: 1.32), higher pre-LVAD blood urea nitrogen level (HR: 1.01 per 1 mg/dL), and pre-LVAD dialysis (HR: 1.91) were significantly associated with death after stroke, whereas higher pre-LVAD body mass index (HR: 1.02 per 1 unit), pre-LVAD serum creatinine (HR: 1.36 per 1 mg/dL), pre-LVAD international normalized ratio (HR: 1.14 per 1 unit), and lower pre-LVAD lower albumin (HR: 0.98 per 1 g/dL) were significantly related to mortality after nonstroke NAE. Pre-LVAD extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (stroke HR: 1.70; nonstroke HR: 1.45) and concomitant surgery (stroke HR: 1.23; nonstroke HR: 1.17) were associated with the occurrence of NAEs.

CONCLUSIONS: Stroke and nonstroke NAEs are incurred by a similar proportion of patients, and both are associated with substantially reduced survival. Consequently, stroke and nonstroke NAEs should be given comparable weight with universal nomenclature when evaluating the safety of durable LVADs. Pre-LVAD extracorporeal membrane oxygenation and concomitant surgery are potentially modifiable targets to reduce neurological dysfunction during Mag-Lev LVAD therapy.

AI.tldr: 在11,739例磁悬浮LVAD患者中，卒中与非卒中神经不良事件各约8%，两者均使死亡风险显著升高（HR分别为7.3和5.1），2年生存率分别降至45%和56%。
AI.motivation: 磁悬浮（Mag-Lev）连续流左心室辅助装置（LVAD）已成为晚期心力衰竭的重要器械治疗手段，但当代队列中神经功能障碍（包括卒中和非卒中神经不良事件）的发生负担、预后影响及危险因素尚不明确；既往研究多集中于早期搏动泵或早期连续流泵，且常仅以卒中为安全性终点，忽略了非卒中神经不良事件的同等重要性。
AI.method: 基于美国多中心STS-INTERMACS数据库的回顾性队列研究，纳入2017年1月1日至2023年3月31日期间接受Mag-Lev LVAD支持的心力衰竭患者，共11,739例。主要终点为Mag-Lev LVAD支持下的生存；采用多因素Cox回归，以卒中/非卒中神经不良事件状态作为时变协变量，比较其与无神经不良事件者的死亡风险；另建立独立多因素Cox模型，分别分析卒中后与非卒中神经不良事件后死亡的相关因素，以及基线临床变量与两类事件发生的关联。中位随访1.4年（Q1-Q3：0.5-2.7年）。
AI.result: 随访期间879例（8%）发生卒中，972例（8%）发生非卒中神经不良事件，9,888例（84%）无神经不良事件。2年时，卒中后与非卒中神经不良事件后的LVAD支持生存率分别为45%和56%（P<0.001）。与无神经不良事件者相比，卒中后死亡风险HR为7.3，非卒中神经不良事件后HR为5.1。卒中后死亡的相关因素包括年龄较大（每增加1岁HR 1.02）、LVAD植入前已置入ICD（HR 1.32）、植入前血尿素氮较高（每1 mg/dL HR 1.01）及植入前透析（HR 1.91）；非卒中神经不良事件后死亡的相关因素包括植入前BMI较高（每1单位HR 1.02）、血清肌酐较高（每1 mg/dL HR 1.36）、INR较高（每1单位HR 1.14）及白蛋白较低（每1 g/dL HR 0.98）。植入前ECMO（卒中HR 1.70；非卒中HR 1.45）和同期合并外科手术（卒中HR 1.23；非卒中HR 1.17）与神经不良事件发生相关。
AI.conclusion: 卒中和非卒中神经不良事件在Mag-Lev LVAD患者中发生率相近，且均与生存显著下降相关，提示在评价耐久性LVAD安全性时应以统一命名体系给予两者同等权重。植入前ECMO和同期合并手术可能是减少Mag-Lev LVAD治疗期间神经功能障碍的潜在可干预靶点。局限性：本研究为回顾性登记数据库分析，事件判定依赖各中心上报，缺乏影像学与神经科评估细节，残余混杂无法排除；部分多因素模型未报告HR的95%置信区间。

summary_zh:
背景：在当代磁悬浮（Mag-Lev）左心室辅助装置（LVAD）支持治疗晚期心力衰竭期间，神经功能障碍的负担尚不确定。

目的：旨在确定Mag-Lev LVAD支持期间卒中和非卒中神经不良事件（NAEs）的发生率、预后和危险因素。

方法：开展了一项回顾性队列研究，使用美国多中心胸外科医师学会INTERMACS数据库，时间为2017年1月1日至2023年3月31日。研究人群包括接受Mag-Lev LVAD支持的心力衰竭患者。主要结局为接受Mag-Lev LVAD支持期间的生存。使用多变量Cox回归，以卒中和非卒中NAE状态作为时变协变量，以确定与无NAE相比的死亡风险。构建了单独的多变量Cox回归模型，以确定卒中和非卒中NAEs后死亡的相关因素，并确定与卒中和非卒中NAE发生相关的基线临床变量。

结果：在11,739例患者中，879例（8%）发生卒中，972例（8%）发生非卒中NAE，9,888例（84%）在中位1.4年（Q1-Q3：0.5-2.7年）内未发生NAE。2年时，卒中和非卒中NAE后接受Mag-Lev LVAD支持的生存率分别为45%和56%（P < 0.001）。与无NAE相比，卒中后（HR：7.3）和非卒中NAE后（HR：5.1）的死亡风险升高。年龄较大（HR：每年1.02）、LVAD植入前植入式心律转复除颤器（HR：1.32）、较高的LVAD植入前血尿素氮水平（HR：每1 mg/dL 1.01）以及LVAD植入前透析（HR：1.91）与卒中后死亡显著相关；而较高的LVAD植入前体重指数（HR：每1单位1.02）、LVAD植入前血清肌酐（HR：每1 mg/dL 1.36）、LVAD植入前国际标准化比值（HR：每1单位1.14）和较低的LVAD植入前白蛋白（HR：每1 g/dL 0.98）与非卒中NAE后死亡率显著相关。LVAD植入前体外膜肺氧合（卒中HR：1.70；非卒中HR：1.45）和同期手术（卒中HR：1.23；非卒中HR：1.17）与NAEs的发生相关。

结论：相似比例的患者发生卒中和非卒中NAEs，且两者均与生存率显著降低相关。因此，在评估耐久性LVAD的安全性时，应通过统一命名对卒中和非卒中NAEs给予同等重视。LVAD植入前体外膜肺氧合和同期手术是减少Mag-Lev LVAD治疗期间神经功能障碍的潜在可干预靶点。

title: FLNC-Related Cardiomyopathies in an Admixed Population: Expanding the Genotype-Phenotype Spectrum and Clinical Correlates.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants in filamin C (FLNC) cause a broad spectrum of cardiomyopathies. However, available genotype-phenotype data are derived predominantly from European and North American populations, with limited representation of admixed populations.

METHODS: We characterized carriers of pathogenic/likely pathogenic FLNC variants identified among 2654 unrelated probands undergoing exome sequencing for suspected inherited cardiomyopathy and their relatives identified through cascade screening. Clinical, electrocardiographic, imaging, genetic, and longitudinal data were analyzed according to cardiomyopathy phenotype and variant class. Genetic ancestry was evaluated. Associations with arrhythmic, heart failure, and composite outcomes were examined in exploratory analyses.

RESULTS: The cohort included 97 carriers (58 probands, 39 relatives), of whom 72 had cardiomyopathy and 25 were phenotype-negative at evaluation. Truncating variants predominated among patients with arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy and dilated cardiomyopathy, whereas missense variants were concentrated among those with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and restrictive cardiomyopathy. Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy and dilated cardiomyopathy were characterized by a greater burden of ventricular arrhythmias, low QRS voltage, systolic dysfunction, and myocardial fibrosis, whereas hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and restrictive cardiomyopathy showed greater wall thickness and more atrial arrhythmias. Twelve pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants absent from gnomAD and ClinVar were identified. Ancestry analysis confirmed heterogeneous genetic backgrounds but detected no ancestry-related differences in variant class or phenotype. In exploratory outcome analyses, nonsustained ventricular tachycardia, low QRS voltage, and late gadolinium enhancement were associated with outcomes.

CONCLUSIONS: This deeply phenotyped Brazilian cohort expands the FLNC variant spectrum and supports broad genotype-phenotype associations across an admixed population. Exploratory findings suggest that markers of ventricular arrhythmia and myocardial fibrosis may complement left ventricular ejection fraction in future risk-stratification strategies, although validation in larger, independent cohorts is required.

AI.tldr: 巴西混合人群中 97 例 FLNC 致病/可能致病变异携带者显示：截短变异多见于致心律失常性和扩张型心肌病，错义变异多见于肥厚型和限制型心肌病；NSVT、低 QRS 电压和 LGE 与不良结局相关。
AI.motivation: FLNC 的致病/可能致病变异可导致从致心律失常性心肌病、扩张型心肌病到肥厚型、限制型心肌病的广谱表型，但现有基因型-表型数据几乎全部来自欧洲和北美人群，混合人群（admixed population）代表性不足，限制了变异解读与风险分层的可推广性。本研究旨在混合人群中系统描述 FLNC 相关心肌病的表型谱与临床相关因素。
AI.method: 在 2654 例因疑似遗传性心肌病接受外显子测序的无亲缘关系先证者中，鉴定 FLNC 致病/可能致病变异携带者，并通过级联筛查纳入其家系成员，共 97 例（58 例先证者、39 例家属）。按心肌病表型和变异类型（截短 vs 错义）分析临床、心电图、影像、遗传及纵向随访数据，并评估遗传祖先。以心律失常结局、心力衰竭结局及复合终点进行探索性关联分析。测序平台细节、随访时长、终点具体定义及统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 97 例携带者中 72 例存在心肌病表型、25 例评估时为表型阴性。截短变异在致心律失常性心肌病和扩张型心肌病中占优势，错义变异集中于肥厚型心肌病和限制型心肌病。致心律失常性及扩张型心肌病表现为室性心律失常负荷更高、低 QRS 电压、收缩功能不全及心肌纤维化更显著；肥厚型及限制型心肌病则室壁厚度更大、房性心律失常更多。共鉴定出 12 个 gnomAD 与 ClinVar 均未收录的致病/可能致病变异。祖先分析证实遗传背景异质，但未发现变异类型或表型与祖先相关的差异。探索性结局分析中，非持续性室性心动过速（NSVT）、低 QRS 电压和延迟钆增强（LGE）与结局相关；具体效应量、95%CI 及 P 值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该深度表型的巴西混合人群队列扩展了 FLNC 变异谱，并支持在该人群中存在较广泛的基因型-表型关联。探索性结果提示，室性心律失常与心肌纤维化标志物未来可能作为 LVEF 之外的补充指标用于风险分层，但尚需在更大规模独立队列中验证。局限性包括样本量小、结局分析为探索性、缺乏对照及随访与统计细节报告不全。

title: Clinical and Genetic Characteristics of Hereditary Arrhythmias and Cardiomyopathies in the Middle East
summary: Inherited arrhythmias and cardiomyopathies are leading causes of sudden cardiac death in young individuals. Although global registries and genetic databases have advanced diagnosis and prevention globally, data from the Middle East (ME) remain limited and fragmented. This review synthesizes clinical and genetic evidence on long QT syndrome, catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, Brugada syndrome, arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and dilated cardiomyopathy across the ME. A defining feature of ME cohorts is the high prevalence of consanguinity, which shapes a distinctive genetic and clinical landscape across these conditions. Autosomal recessive inheritance is consistently enriched, producing homozygous genotypes, which frequently manifest as earlier onset and more aggressive clinical phenotypes compared with those in non-ME populations. Population-specific founder variants have been identified across multiple conditions, whereas consanguineous pedigrees have contributed to the discovery of novel disease genes and recessive mechanisms that expand the global genetic landscape of inherited cardiovascular disease. However, a disproportionately high burden of variants of uncertain significance persists across conditions, driven largely by underrepresentation of ME populations in global genomic reference databases. Emerging large-scale genome initiatives such as the Qatar Biobank, the Egyptian Genome Project, and the Greater Middle East Variome offer a viable path toward ancestry-specific variant interpretation. Strengthening regional registries, genomic resources, and family-based screening programs will be essential to improving risk stratification and prevention of sudden cardiac death in the ME.

summary_zh: 遗传性心律失常和心肌病是年轻个体发生心脏性猝死的主要原因。尽管全球登记注册和遗传数据库已在全球范围内推进了诊断和预防，但中东（ME）的数据仍然有限且碎片化。本综述综合了中东地区关于长QT综合征、儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速、Brugada综合征、致心律失常性右心室心肌病、肥厚型心肌病和扩张型心肌病的临床与遗传学证据。中东队列的一个决定性特征是近亲婚配高度流行，这塑造了这些疾病在该地区独特的遗传和临床格局。常染色体隐性遗传 consistently enriched，产生纯合基因型，与非中东人群相比，这些基因型常表现为更早发病和更具侵袭性的临床表型。已在多种疾病中鉴定出人群特异性奠基者变异，而近亲家系则有助于发现新的疾病基因和隐性机制，从而扩展了遗传性心血管疾病的全球遗传图谱。然而，各疾病中仍持续存在不成比例的高意义未明变异（VUS）负担，这主要归因于中东人群在全球基因组参考数据库中代表性不足。卡塔尔生物样本库、埃及基因组计划和大中东变异组计划等新兴大规模基因组计划，为祖先特异性变异解读提供了可行路径。加强区域登记、基因组资源和基于家庭的筛查项目，对于改善中东地区的风险分层和预防心脏性猝死至关重要。
